requirements: R1: The system must display the Moodle role hierarchy mapping in the UI or API response.

slices.title: Patch Moodle role hierarchy display
slices.jtbd: When implementing the role mapping display for this epic, I want to patch the existing UI code to render the hierarchy, so that the administrator can verify the role mapping.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the role mapping exists in the database, When an administrator views the role settings, Then they should see a visual display showing the mapped hierarchy.
Given the requirement for QA testing, When the feature is patched, Then unit, integration, and E2E tests must verify the mapped hierarchy is displayed correctly.

requirements: R1: Session tokens must not be passed as URL query parameters in the SSO redirect.
R2: Session tokens must be delivered securely, such as via secure cookies or passed in a JSON body to an interim endpoint.

slices.title: Patch SSO secure token delivery
slices.jtbd: When implementing secure token delivery for this epic, I want to modify the redirect logic to use secure mechanisms, so that session tokens are not leaked in URL query parameters.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a successful SSO login, When the system redirects back to the frontend, Then the access and refresh tokens must not be included in the URL query string.
Given an SSO validation or auth failure, When the user is redirected, Then the system must correctly deny access and not issue tokens.
Given the requirement for QA testing, When the SSO logic is patched, Then integration tests must verify tokens are delivered securely without leaking in the URL.
